# Disaster Analytics for Society Lab @NTU

> A research laboratory at Nanyang Technological University advancing disaster risk science through analytics, climate modeling, and resilience quantification.

Led by David Lallemant, the lab conducts cutting-edge research on flood mapping, sea-level rise, and disaster risk reduction with a focus on Southeast Asia and vulnerable communities. The team combines data science, remote sensing, and probabilistic modeling to inform climate adaptation and disaster preparedness.

## Key Topics

- Disaster Risk Reduction
- Flood Mapping & Simulation
- Climate Change & Sea-Level Rise
- Probabilistic Risk Assessment
- Resilience Quantification
- Remote Sensing & AI
- Natural Hazards
- Disaster Impact Assessment
- Southeast Asia
- Flow-Tub Model
- David Lallemant
- Nanyang Technological University
- Earth Observatory of Singapore
- COP30 Climate Action
- Multi-Hazard Risk Analysis
